description.zh: 身份认证渠道列表。枚举取值：email（邮件）、sms（短信）
description.en:
The list of authentication channels. Valid values:
- email: email.
- sms: text message.

description.zh: 忘记密码配置状态。枚举取值：enabled（开启）、disabled（禁用）
description.en:
The forgot password configuration status. Valid values:
- enabled: enabled.
- disabled: disabled.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam set-forget-password-configuration --instance-id eiam-111ccc1111 --forget-password-status enabled --authentication-channels sms --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam SetForgetPasswordConfiguration --region cn-hangzhou --ForgetPasswordStatus enabled --InstanceId 'eiam-111ccc1111' --AuthenticationChannels.1 sms --method POST --force
